newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Email knows no reason for share rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Email knows no reason for share rise.

text.p: Appliance manufacturer Email Ltd said on Monday in reply to a query from the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) that it knew of reason for the recent rise in its share price.
The ASX had asked Email about the rise in Email's share price to A$3.44 on Friday from A$3.09 on Tuesday and an increase in the volume of trading in the securities over this period.
"The company can offer no explanation why the price has moved to the extent it has," Email said in a letter to the ASX.
Email reported a net profit of A$55.14 million for the 1995/96 year ending March 31, down from A$100.13 million in 1994/95 but said it was budgetting for an improvement in 1996/97.
In early September, brokerage J.B. Were and Son said in a report that it recommended Email as a buy, reflecting the benefits of an improving Australian economy.
